title: PUMP vs NITRICOXIDE
directVerdict: PUMP is the maximum dedicated pump formula; NITRICOXIDE is the more rounded stimulant-free pump, focus, and endurance formula.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only PUMP discloses: Betaine Anhydrous: 2.5 g per 2 scoops; Taurine: 2 g per 2 scoops; Betaine Nitrate: 2 g per 2 scoops; Arginine Nitrate: 1 g per 2 scoops; BioPerine: 5 mg per 2 scoops.

Only NITRICOXIDE discloses: Watermelon Juice Powder: 1 g per full serving; PeakO2 Mushroom Blend: 1 g per full serving; Dextrose: 1 g per full serving; L-Tyrosine: 1 g per full serving; CitraPeak: 200 mg per full serving; Pine Bark Extract: 180 mg per full serving; Ginkgo Biloba: 120 mg per full serving.
PUMP caffeine: PUMP is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine. NITRICOXIDE caffeine: NITRICOXIDE is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: PUMP leads with 8 g L-Citrulline plus 2 g betaine nitrate and 1 g arginine nitrate, backed by betaine, taurine, and salt. NITRICOXIDE uses 5 g L-Citrulline with watermelon powder, a 1 g mushroom blend, CitraPeak, pine bark, tyrosine, and ginkgo.
tradeoffs: PUMP: Customers asking for stimulant energy
NITRICOXIDE: Customers asking specifically for stimulant energy
bottomLine: Choose PUMP when the customer wants nitrates and the strongest pump-specific profile. Choose NITRICOXIDE when they want a stimulant-free pre-workout with pump plus more focus/endurance positioning.
